title: Tools of Destruction USA v02.00 executable and save research map

binary.address_space: Original ELF virtual addresses, NOT file offsets, save offsets or emulator host RAM addresses. Rebasing is not supported.

annotations.name: TOD_PS3_function_descriptors
annotations.comment: 23910 eight-byte big-endian descriptors: uint32 code VA, uint32 r2 TOC base. End exclusive 0x887F38. Three TOCs, not one; do not decode as 24-byte native PPC64 descriptors.
annotations.evidence: ELF section 22, file offset 0x849408, size 0x2EB30; all 23910 records inspected.

annotations.name: TOD_PS3_entry_descriptor
annotations.comment: ELF e_entry points here. Actual entry code is 0x14360 with r2 = 0x88FF38, not instructions at the descriptor address.
